metadata.title: Implement Compact Mode for Habit Cards

acceptanceCriteria.title: Compact Mode Toggle
checks: Settings menu includes a "Compact Mode" toggle option
Toggle persists across app sessions (saved to device storage)
Toggle state loads on app startup
Toggle immediately updates UI when changed

acceptanceCriteria.title: Compact Habit Card Layout
checks: In compact mode, habit card vertical padding reduces from 20px to 12px
Gap between habit cards reduces from 16px to 8px
Habit name font size reduces from 18px to 16px
Chain visualization circles reduce from 40px to 32px diameter
Streak label font size reduces from 12px to 10px
Emoji size reduces from 24px to 20px

acceptanceCriteria.title: Default Mode Preserved
checks: When compact mode is OFF, all original spacing from Story 1.1 is maintained
20px card padding (top/bottom)
16px gap between cards
Original font sizes and component dimensions

acceptanceCriteria.title: Smooth Transitions
checks: Layout changes animate smoothly when toggling compact mode
No jarring jumps or layout shifts
Animation duration: 200-300ms

acceptanceCriteria.title: Responsive Design
checks: Compact mode works correctly on iOS, Android, and Web
Layout remains readable and usable in compact mode
Touch targets remain accessible (minimum 32px for interactive elements)

constraints: Animation performance must remain smooth with many habits
Text must remain readable at reduced sizes

unit: Style changes for compact vs default modes
manual: Toggle compact mode in settings and verify immediate UI update
Restart app and verify setting persistence
Verify spacing and sizes per AC2
